ln_shoutout.error.cooldown: Twitch rejected the shoutout: cooldown. Two minutes between shoutouts, sixty for the same channel.
ln_shoutout.error.forbidden: Twitch denies the shoutout. The “shoutouts” permission is probably missing.
ln_shoutout.error.no_target_id: The Twitch id of the target channel is unknown.
ln_shoutout.error.unauthorized: Twitch rejected the sign-in. The channel has to be reconnected.
ln_shoutout.name: Live notification - Shoutout
